#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Convert documented fixed-width warehouse records to CSV."""

import csv
import sys

RECORD_WIDTH = 21
ID_END = 5
NAME_END = 17


def reject(rejects, line_number, record, reason):
    printable = record.decode("ascii", errors="backslashreplace")
    rejects.write("{}: {} [{}]\n".format(line_number, printable, reason))


def main():
    if len(sys.argv) != 2:
        sys.stderr.write("usage: {} INPUT\n".format(sys.argv[0]))
        return 2

    writer = csv.writer(sys.stdout, lineterminator="\n")
    writer.writerow(("id", "name", "quantity"))

    with open(sys.argv[1], "rb") as source, open("rejects.txt", "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as rejects:
        for line_number, raw_line in enumerate(source, 1):
            record = raw_line[:-1] if raw_line.endswith(b"\n") else raw_line
            if len(record) != RECORD_WIDTH:
                reject(rejects, line_number, record, "wrong length: {}".format(len(record)))
                continue

            quantity = record[NAME_END:]
            if len(quantity) != 4 or not all(48 <= byte <= 57 for byte in quantity):
                reject(rejects, line_number, record, "nonnumeric quantity")
                continue

            try:
                record_id = record[:ID_END].decode("ascii")
                name = record[ID_END:NAME_END].decode("ascii").rstrip(" ")
                quantity_text = quantity.decode("ascii")
            except UnicodeDecodeError:
                reject(rejects, line_number, record, "non-ASCII data")
                continue

            writer.writerow((record_id, name, quantity_text))

    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
PY_EOF
